meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 OpenCode 配置管理多种 AI 模型提供商
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器化环境中切换不同 AI 模型提供商
copy.tagline_en: Manage multiple AI model providers via OpenCode config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to switch between AI model providers in containerized environments

howto.what: 安装并启用 OpenCode 作为 NanoClaw 的 agent 后端，让 agent 组可选择 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等模型来源，而不只用默认的 Claude。安装时复制 provider 文件、注册依赖并重建镜像。
howto.when: 当某个 agent 组通过 `ncl groups config update --provider opencode` 被设为 opencode 并重启后生效；主机同时把 OPENCODE_PROVIDER、OPENCODE_MODEL 等传入容器。缺少 provider 文件时也会触发安装。

say.text: 把 group-abc 的 agent provider 改为 opencode
say.note: 该组重启后由 OpenCode 驱动 agent。

say.text: 帮我配置 DeepSeek 作为 opencode 的模型
say.note: 写入 OPENCODE_PROVIDER 与模型 ID 等。

howto.what_en: Installs and enables OpenCode as an agent provider for NanoClaw, letting agent groups use model sources like OpenRouter, DeepSeek, etc. instead of only the default Claude. It copies provider files, registers dependencies, and rebuilds the image.
howto.when_en: Takes effect when an agent group is set to opencode via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode` and restarted; host passes OPENCODE_PROVIDER, OPENCODE_MODEL, etc. into the container. Also runs when provider files are missing.

say_en.text: Set group-abc's agent provider to opencode
say_en.note: Restart and the group is driven by OpenCode.

say_en.text: Configure DeepSeek as the opencode model for me

say_en.note: Sets OPENCODE_MODEL and registers the key.
